name: Indianapolis Motor Speedway (Road Course)
summary: Home of the Indy 500, with a road course laid inside the oval for Formula 1.
character: An infield road course joined to part of the oval, so the lap ended with a flat-out run through the banked last corner and down the long front straight.

moments.title: Six cars on the grid
moments.body: In 2005, Michelin's tyres weren't safe on the banking, so all 14 Michelin cars pulled into the pits after the formation lap. Six cars raced, and Michael Schumacher won.

history.body: The Indy 500 counted for the World Championship, though almost no F1 regulars entered.
First United States Grand Prix on the road course.

leftCalendar: The track and F1 couldn't agree terms after 2007. The US Grand Prix came back in 2012 at the Circuit of the Americas.
